versions.name: Egle v2.0.0
versions.notes:
- Smart Playlists: build a playlist from a plain-language query like 90s r&b or most played, fully offline, and save it to your Library or straight onto a Rockbox DAP. Saving onto a DAP is a Supporter feature.
- Playlist transfer Library to DAP: Egle matches the same songs across PC and device even when the paths differ, writes the playlist on the DAP, and can copy over the missing songs too.
- Manage DAP playlists: a new PC / DAP switch on the Playlists page lists, opens, creates, renames and deletes the playlists on your connected device, and the Add to playlist menu can drop a song straight onto a device playlist (copying it across first if it is not there yet). Writing to the DAP is a Supporter feature.
- Any folder layout in the DAP Manager: Auto mode finds albums at any depth, so Artist / Album / file libraries (MusicBee, iTunes, foobar2000, NAS) finally show up, and copies are mirrored on the DAP with the same structure.
- DAP Manager advanced scan: compare tags and audio quality of the files you have on both PC and DAP, see what differs (quality, tags or modified), and re-sync the ones you pick in either direction. Live speed and ETA, smooth with thousands of files, and a clean cancel.
- ReplayGain in the Massive Tag Editor: measure the loudness of each track or the whole album and write the standard ReplayGain tags, so your library plays at an even volume. Both the player and Rockbox read them.
- New Duplicates page: finds songs that appear more than once, even across formats like FLAC and MP3, marks the best copy, and moves the rest to the Recycle Bin, with optional album renumbering afterwards. Finding is free; deleting is a Supporter feature.
- Gapless and crossfade: play albums with no gap between tracks, or blend one track into the next (up to 12 s). Both off by default, in Settings under Player.
- Immersive lyrics view: a Spotify-style Now Playing with the lyrics large on the right and the current line highlighted, click a line to jump. Lyrics can also come from an external .lrc file. Smoother scrolling and transitions.
- Richer browsing pages: artist, genre and year pages now have the full three dots menu, a Play all button, and a grid / track-list toggle. History rows are clickable, and empty dash genres are gone.
- Consistent back and forward: full screen and library detail pages are now real history steps, so back, forward and Escape move through Picture Flow, Now Playing and album/artist/genre pages as expected. Last session also restores a fullscreen Picture Flow and your scroll position.
- Now Playing controls: the heart and add to playlist buttons sit next to the playback controls, and the cover highlight is a softer glowing frame.
- Live palette preview: press Preview to see Egle recolored with your palette in real time, with a Dark / Light switch and a plain description on every color.
- Crash-safe settings: the settings file can no longer be left half written, and Egle restores from a backup if it is ever found damaged, so a crash during a save no longer resets your preferences.
- Smaller fixes: sidebar reordered (Library, DAP Manager, Massive Tag Editor, EQ Converter, FLAC Checker); DAP album list refreshes itself after a transfer; Settings opens on the right tool's section; a corrupt file no longer crashes a scan; startup picker shows DAP Manager properly; the Picture Flow mini player title opens fullscreen Now Playing; and the Add to playlist menu no longer shows an empty strip.

versions.name: Egle v1.1.0
versions.notes:
- Massive Tag Editor: a 9-operation pipeline (clear field, find/replace regex, normalize artist separators, capitalization, renumber tracks, clean hidden characters, sync ARTIST/ALBUMARTIST, remove non-standard tags, normalize values with auto-detection of spelling variants) plus bulk cover art, diff preview, in-memory undo with snapshot history, and an optional .bak backup. Free: up to 100 files per operation; Supporter: unlimited.
- Massive Tag Editor — Ready recipes: one-click operation presets that fill the queue with no manual setup, ordered by usefulness — fill the missing Album Artist (fixes duplicate albums), strip featuring from artists and titles, unify the separators between artists, remove [Explicit]/[Clean] (including variants like Explicit Version), fix capitalization (Title Case), clean hidden characters and spaces, empty junk comment fields (COMMENT/DESCRIPTION), plus an all-in-one iPod/DAP cleanup combo. The featuring cleanup now also catches feat/ft written without a dot. Nothing is applied automatically: you run Preview/Apply as always.
- Massive Tag Editor — quality of life: every operation can be muted (it stays in the queue but is skipped on run) without deleting it, and invalid regex patterns are flagged in real time (red border), blocking Preview/Apply until you fix them.
- Custom Library Path Tree: the library structure adapts to any folder layout (presets plus a token template with live preview and multi-CD merge).
- Playlist import/export: M3U / M3U8 / PLS, with cascading path resolution and #EXTINF enriched from the library metadata.
- Tag backup from the Library: tag_editor_create_backup flag (default ON); manage and restore the .bak files from the Massive Tag Editor.
- Palette fix: corrected contrast on the greenish/yellowish fields across all default palettes.
- Startup fix: window position and size are restored from the last session; the minimized-window case is handled correctly.
- Multi-format: verified compatibility of all tools on FLAC/MP3/M4A/AAC/OGG/Opus/WAV/AIFF (the FLAC Authenticity Checker stays FLAC-only by design).
- Debug logging: logs at the critical points, viewable from Settings.
- HDD scan optimization: faster library scanning on mechanical drives.
- Massive Tag Editor — HDD optimization: applying tag and cover changes now limits parallel work on mechanical drives (like the scan phases already did), reducing head thrashing and improving throughput on large HDD libraries.
- Reworked and improved Artists view.

versions.name: Egle v1.0.4
versions.notes: - Added a Settings option to choose how your library folder tree is structured (auto, Album, Artist/Album, Genre/Artist/Album).

versions.name: Egle v1.0.3
versions.notes:
- Translations: 125 missing strings added for French, Spanish, German, Portuguese and Japanese (they previously fell back to English).
- Maintenance: backend command files and the Settings view split into per-area modules, plus a first batch of backend unit tests. No behavior change.
- Added options for the day and night theme modes.
- Improved statistics view.

versions.name: Egle v1.0.0
versions.notes:
- First public release of the Egle Audio Suite: one app to manage your music library, tune your Rockbox EQ, organize your DAP and listen in HiFi.
- Multi-codec HiFi player with bit-perfect playback.
- EQ Converter, DAP Manager, Tag Editor and Spectral Analyzer.
- Music Library with Picture Flow, playlists and a Now Playing view.
